title: Speech to text (STT): accuracy, language and domain vocabulary

videos.script: Every lesson so far has used Whisper. This one asks how good it actually is, and how to make it better at the words your business uses. {{title}} The measure is the word error rate. Count the words that were swapped, dropped or added, and divide by the words that were said. {{wer}} It is a good number, and it hides things. It treats a lost "the" and a wrong order number as the same mistake. {{hides}} You will compare two sizes of Whisper on three recordings. A clean call, a phone line and a noisy one. {{sizes}} Then a Portuguese voicemail, and what happens when you tell Whisper the wrong language. {{language}} And then the shop's own words. A Brazilian novel, its author and the shop's name, heard by a model trained mostly on English. {{vocab}} Some of those errors can be fixed after the fact, with a list of words the shop knows. Some cannot, and the lesson says which. {{end}}
